# copypaste.fyi

Type. Get link. Share. A pastebin for humans and agents.

## Product
1. POST text
2. Receive /p/{id}
3. Share that URL. There is no public listing.

## Create
POST https://www.copypaste.fyi/api/pastes
Content-Type: application/json
{"content":"hello","format":"plain_text"}

Closed instance: header X-CopyPaste-Write-Token.

Optional encryption (server-side AES-256-GCM / ChaCha20-Poly1305):
{"content":"hello","format":"plain_text","encryption":{"algorithm":"aes256_gcm","key":"<secret>"}}

## Read
GET https://www.copypaste.fyi/api/pastes/{id}
Encrypted: header X-Paste-Key (never ?key= in new clients)
Raw: GET /raw/{id}

Missing, burned, and expired are the same 404.

## Agents
Discovery: https://www.copypaste.fyi/.well-known/copypaste.json
Grok Bot skill: https://www.copypaste.fyi/grok-bot.md
CLI: copypaste send --agent "text"   # JSON receipt with tokens

Do not put write tokens or encryption keys in argv, query strings, or Open-with URLs.
Encryption is server-side, not E2E.
